## BoardGamesWithQuests repository

The committed repository contains a Python engine, controller, game/piece/user models, chess and checkers configuration JSON, source-derived documentation and GitHub automation. Runtime capabilities require genuine external behavior testing; code presence alone is not proof.

The [generated repository PRD](PRD.md) describes only these current source boundaries. Prospective product requirements, API/DB/DSL contracts, browser/native work and game milestones are recorded solely in [master issue #348](https://github.com/marius-patrik/BoardGamesWithQuests/issues/348) and [contract issue #350](https://github.com/marius-patrik/BoardGamesWithQuests/issues/350).

## Tracked repository structure

Physical `.agents/` and `.github/` directories own documentation, governance and automation. The `.agents/{notes,requests,decisions,rules}/` source records generate `.agents/{README,PRD,ARCHITECTURE,AGENTS}.md`, and root `README.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` are symlinks. `.agents/{GOAL,PLAN,TODO,SCRATCHPAD}.md` are concise maintenance records.

`.agents/architecture/diagrams/` contains source-derived actual-code diagrams; `.agents/reference/` contains the original assignment artwork and reference diagrams, not current implementation contracts. The `.agents/agents/` and `.agents/skills/` trees are portable agent guidance; tests and fixtures are under `.github/tests/`. DarkFactory integration is configured by the existing tracked `.darkfactory/installation.json` file; this repository does not have a root Git submodule. Contribution policy lives in the [generated rules](AGENTS.md), not this overview.

## Native GitHub protection verification

`repo.dfconfig` declares the intended `main` branch protection, but only GitHub's actual settings enforce it. Inspect the live settings with a repository administrator's GitHub CLI identity:

```bash
python3 .github/scripts/apply_branch_protection.py
```

The script is dry-run by default. Only use `--apply` after approval and after comparing the actual protection; divergent existing policies require an additional explicit `--replace`. PR review and required status checks must be verified against GitHub, not inferred from repository configuration.

## Contribution and verification

Every change starts from its tracked issue and is proposed through a focused pull request. Before editing, inspect the actual branch, source files, existing tests and provider status. A successful build or green structural test does not establish gameplay or deployed integration.

Canonical documents are generated from approved `.agents/notes/`, `.agents/requests/`, `.agents/decisions/` and `.agents/rules/` records. Verify these records and projections together:

```bash
python3 .github/scripts/generate_documents.py --write
python3 .github/scripts/generate_documents.py --check
python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/tests -p test_repository_structure.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/tests -p test_apply_branch_protection.py
```

Behavioral Python tests run with `pytest` after installing the relevant development dependencies. The documentation preview workflow builds the rendered site, exercises `.github/tests/docs_site_acceptance.py` and `.github/tests/test_docs_browser.mjs`, then publishes a preview through GitHub Pages Actions. Claims of real provider readiness require separate live verification.

The project's review branch and release gate are the ones actually configured in GitHub and `repo.dfconfig`. PRs must not merge or release automatically without explicit maintainer authorization; the `.darkfactory/` installation metadata is repository-owned and is not a Git submodule.
